title: runtime copy: the permission-set clone notice says "authored in this environment" beside the console's new "this system" — server-side user-facing strings still use the cloud noun (cloud#3002 ruling A)
body:
**Filing gate ①, class (a): user-visible copy that contradicts a ruling.** From the out-of-scope finding in the dev report on objectstack-ai/objectui#12960 (`6250050271`), re-read by objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_0188TsgPV8kQXfuRuKmkj2ks`) at objectstack `main` on 2026-10-18. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

## What a user sees

1. In Setup, a user clones a package-provided permission set.
2. Once objectstack-ai/objectui PR #12962 lands, the editor's own hint reads "the copy is an ordinary permission set authored in **this system**".
3. The success notice right under it, which the editor shows verbatim from the clone door (`perm-clone-notice`), reads "The copy is a new permission set authored in **this environment** …".

So the same flow names the same thing twice in different words. The notice's text is `packages/runtime/src/domains/permission-set-clone.ts:118`, the door's success response. objectui's `PermissionMatrixEditor.cloneToCustomize.test.tsx` mirrors it "as the door sends it".

## The rule

objectstack-ai/cloud#3002 ruling A (the maintainer, 2026-10-18), as objectui applied it: inside the running system, a user-facing string names the system the user is in as "this system" / 「本系统」, or drops the noun. objectui has applied it to its locale packs (objectui#12956, PR #12959) and to the metadata designer's table (objectui#12960, PR #12962).

Before that, objectui#12865 named the running instance "Environment", and the server copy below still follows that naming.

## Scope triage should read

`git grep -n 'this environment' origin/main -- 'packages/**/*.ts' ':!**/*.test.ts' ':!**/__tests__/**'` gives 134 non-test lines. Most are comments. The user-facing strings among them include:
- `runtime/src/domains/permission-set-clone.ts:118`, the clone notice above;
- `runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts:77` and `:164`: "MCP server is not enabled for this environment" (404 body);
- `runtime/src/domains/share-links.ts:177`: "Sharing is not configured for this environment" (501 body);
- `runtime/src/domains/webhooks.ts:120` and `:131`, the redelivery refusals;
- `objectql/src/default-record-page.ts:163` and `objectql/src/security-catalog-namespace.ts:212`, holder names that reach refusal messages;
- `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:1143`, `:1247` and `:22110`, protocol refusal text;
- `platform-objects/src/system/sys-metadata-activation.object.ts:151`, a field description.

Some of these may mean a configuration scope rather than "the system you are in". That is the same per-string judgment triage made for objectui#12960 (`6249658907`).

## Before acting

**Dedupe caveat:** this session cannot read objectstack-ai/cloud, so cloud#3002's inventory was not read. If that inventory already has a group for the framework's server copy, this card duplicates it and should close.

**Dedupe:** a REST read of both repositories' issues updated since 2026-10-17 (200 issues), grepped for `PERMISSION_SET_CLONE_NOTICE`, "authored in this environment", "cloud#3002", "this environment", 此环境 and 本环境. The hits are only objectui#12956, #12959, #12960, #12962 and #12865 (all objectui copy). None is a server-copy card.
